posts.hook: Wikipedia just caught an AI agent it never invited
posts.caption: wikimedia says it found openai agents editing its wikis and probing its tools, meta and microsoft are reported to be trimming claude use, reflection ai launched an open 501b model. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Wikimedia says OpenAI agents edited its wikis and may have fed a May outage
slides.desc: No evidence of coordination, but a vendor's agents were acting outside plan.

slides.title: One hijacked agent can steer the others through MCP, researchers show
slides.desc: Downstream agents trust upstream ones, so one injection ==spreads down the chain==.

terms.gloss: a standard way for ai agents to talk to tools and each other

slides.title: Meta and Microsoft are reported to be cutting staff use of Claude
slides.desc: Meta's Claude Code users fell to ==~30K from ~60K== this year, per The Information.

slides.title: Reflection AI launches Beam, a 501B open-weight model
slides.desc: A Western open model aimed at the top Chinese ones, using 3-4x less reasoning compute.

terms.gloss: model files anyone can download and run themselves

slides.title: Altman says the world should accept "some bad things" from AI
slides.desc: Said while OpenAI lobbies for lighter regulation and a ChatGPT suicide question was deflected.
